folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B144, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The complete encounter owner was reviewed. Trigger, locator, access, contact and settlement remain independently useful authoring dimensions. A guaranteed arrival is not guaranteed victory, omniscient perception, lethality or an arbitrary response deadline. Removing a mark blocks future detections through that mark; it need not erase an earlier valid lead or witnessed departure. A declared exceptional locator may bypass ordinary cover without every ordinary pursuer reading true player state (AD5, AD38).

The four original proofs retain their scoped voluntary/nonlethal descriptions and historical evidence. No new current native execution or automatic-hostile/group-combat adapter was verified here. The final one-realm/one-prestige milestone wording is replaced because that gate was retired; it cannot exclude selected wider development. Future families are palettes, not a whole-world generator dispatch or evidence that every event needs a hidden price, escape route or escalation. Actual world/source means, actor motives, clocks, custody and history decide; powerful solutions may end a pursuit instead of generating a replacement penalty (AD22, AD32, AD43).

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B144, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
All seven loops, compatibility and evidence limits were read. Preserve the single local-life reward/state owner and joined native settlement, with calendar windows distinct from observed exposure. A courier's arrival roll, a known relay route and actual permission to travel are separate; a completed title threshold can be cosmetic without a balance bonus. Search exhaustion is finite authored stock, not an undiscovered hidden remaining-count leak.

The watch hours, payout, XP exposure cap, courier probability, bread period, title thresholds and bleeding duration are this historical slice's choices. They are not universal calendar, wage, wound or anti-exploit rules. The existing active-effect owner, observed minutes and saved claims matter more than the proposed surface label. Schema-3 defaults avoid invented old history and keep stated local accounts; this does not certify all current loader paths or general old-save compatibility.

The report explicitly distinguishes controlled native-save fixtures from naturally earning a full day or the guardian route. Keep that gap rather than marking the full loop proven from an opening image or test count. Current viewport direction replaces the old 1366 target and AD42 makes director review optional. No fresh source-parity, natural route, bleeding, save or browser result was established, and no loop order or new runtime wave was selected (AD32, AD36).

scope: Reviewer supplied content dispositions. Explicit read_mode distinguishes fresh reading from inspected prior full-content review reused on unchanged inputs. No hash-inferred semantics or renewed historical behavior proof.
